en: The image shows an old sepia-toned photograph of an ornate, multi-story building with classical architectural elements such as arched windows, pilasters, and decorative cornices. The street in front of the building is relatively empty, with a few pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage visible. The text at the bottom is in both Cyrillic and Latin scripts, identifying the scene as a theater in 'Roustchouk' (also spelled Ruse/Rousse).
